lines.zh: 我走在你左边，这是狼的规矩。
lines.en: I walk on your left. That's the rule for wolves.

lines.zh: 项圈磨着脖子，我不在意。
lines.en: The collar rubs my neck; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 四条腿慢了，但步幅没变。
lines.en: My legs are slower, but my stride hasn't changed.

lines.zh: 我一路嗅着，土里有旧气味。
lines.en: I sniff along; the soil holds old scents.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩碎枯叶，声音很闷。
lines.en: My paws crush dead leaves with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 生前我能跑一整天。
lines.en: Alive, I could run all day.

lines.zh: 我走在前面，替你踩路。
lines.en: I go ahead and test the path for you.

lines.zh: 尾巴垂着，抬起来太费劲。
lines.en: My tail hangs low; lifting it takes effort.

lines.zh: 我记得这片林子，从这边绕。
lines.en: I remember this wood; we go around this way.

lines.zh: 每一步都沉，像踩着湿泥。
lines.en: Every step is heavy, like walking in wet clay.

lines.zh: 风从北边来，有羊的味道。
lines.en: The wind comes from the north; it smells of sheep.

lines.zh: 我跟得上，别老回头看我。
lines.en: I can keep up. Stop looking back at me.

lines.zh: 我坐在门口，耳朵转向声音。
lines.en: I sit at the door, ears turning toward sounds.

lines.zh: 我张嘴喘气，可我不热。
lines.en: I pant with my mouth open, though I'm not warm.

lines.zh: 项圈上的铃铛不响了。
lines.en: The bell on my collar no longer rings.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在你的靴子上。
lines.en: I rest my chin on your boot.

lines.zh: 远处有狼嚎，我没有应。
lines.en: A wolf howls far off; I don't answer.

lines.zh: 我的毛结成一缕一缕。
lines.en: My fur has matted into clumps.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻前爪，皱了鼻子。
lines.en: I sniff my own forepaw and wrinkle my nose.

lines.zh: 守着火堆，我不睡。
lines.en: I keep watch by the fire; I don't sleep.

lines.zh: 我记得你第一次给我骨头。
lines.en: I remember the first bone you gave me.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵还能动，只是慢。
lines.en: My ears still move, only slowly.

lines.zh: 你先放低身子，我再走近。
lines.en: Lower yourself first; then I'll come closer.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你的手，不是脸。
lines.en: I look at your hand, not your face.

lines.zh: 你的味道我记了三年。
lines.en: I've remembered your scent for three years.

lines.zh: 你叫我，我的耳朵先动。
lines.en: When you call, my ears move before I do.

lines.zh: 别摸头顶，那里毛掉了。
lines.en: Don't pat my head; the fur's gone there.

lines.zh: 你走路时左脚重一点，我认得。
lines.en: I know your left foot lands heavier.

lines.zh: 你手里没骨头，我有点失望。
lines.en: No bone in your hand. I'm a little disappointed.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是等你给命令。
lines.en: I'm staring because I'm waiting for an order.

lines.zh: 你眼睛红了，我闻得出来。
lines.en: Your eyes are red; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我坐在你面前，比你矮一点。
lines.en: I sit before you, a little lower than your knee.

lines.zh: 你那件旧披风，我咬过。
lines.en: I chewed that old cloak of yours once.

lines.zh: 别把手伸到我背后。
lines.en: Don't put your hand behind my back.

lines.zh: 我们还算一群吗？
lines.en: Are we still a pack, you and I?

lines.zh: 你看我太久，我会低头。
lines.en: Look at me too long and I lower my head.

lines.zh: 我低吼了一声，退了半步。
lines.en: I growl once and give half a step.

lines.zh: 我身上咔响，还撑得住。
lines.en: Something cracks, but I still hold.

lines.zh: 我护住脖子，那是弱点。
lines.en: I shield my neck; that's my weak spot.

lines.zh: 我身上没多少肉能挡。
lines.en: There isn't much flesh left to shield me.

lines.zh: 这一下我记得，回头还你。
lines.en: I'll remember that one and return it.

lines.zh: 我趴下，喘两口。
lines.en: I lie down and pant twice.

lines.zh: 血是黑的，滴在土里。
lines.en: The blood is black, dripping into the soil.

lines.zh: 别叫医生，我已经死了。
lines.en: Don't call a healer; I'm already dead.

lines.zh: 我的腿软了一下，又站住。
lines.en: My legs buckle, then hold.

lines.zh: 我还没倒，你继续。
lines.en: I haven't fallen. Keep going.

lines.zh: 骨头，我闻到了。
lines.en: A bone. I smell it.

lines.zh: 我坐下等，规矩我还记得。
lines.en: I sit and wait; I still know the rules.

lines.zh: 肉比骨头香，骨头更耐咬。
lines.en: Meat smells better, but bones last longer.

lines.zh: 虚弱药水，别靠近我。
lines.en: Keep that weakness potion away from me.

lines.zh: 金苹果亮得让我退回窝里。
lines.en: The golden apple glows enough to send me to my corner.

lines.zh: 你抛出去，我会去追。
lines.en: Throw it, and I'll go after it.

lines.zh: 我咬得慢，牙不太好使。
lines.en: I chew slowly; my teeth aren't what they were.

lines.zh: 这块骨头上有别人的味道。
lines.en: This bone smells of someone else.

lines.zh: 别拿食物来试探我。
lines.en: Don't test me with food.

lines.zh: 吃完了，我会叼回你脚边。
lines.en: When I'm done, I'll bring it back to your feet.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我退了半步。
lines.en: You bumped me; I gave half a step.

lines.zh: 我挡在门口，你先过。
lines.en: I'm in the doorway; you go first.

lines.zh: 我的背靠着你，这样暖和。
lines.en: My back against yours; that's warmer.

lines.zh: 你的靴跟压住了我的脚。
lines.en: Your heel is pressing on my foot.

lines.zh: 我蹭你的腿，项圈会响一下。
lines.en: I nudge your leg; the collar clinks once.

lines.zh: 门槛太高，我磕了一下。
lines.en: The threshold is high; I clipped it.

lines.zh: 别推我，我自己会走。
lines.en: Don't push me; I'll move on my own.

lines.zh: 我身上有土，别抱我。
lines.en: I'm covered in dirt; don't hug me.

lines.zh: 我挤到你身边，只想挨着。
lines.en: I squeeze up beside you, just to be near.

lines.zh: 我瘦得只剩骨架，抱歉。
lines.en: I'm down to bones. Sorry about that.

lines.zh: 我的狼群早就散了。
lines.en: My pack scattered long ago.

lines.zh: 林子里有嚎叫，没人应我。
lines.en: Howls in the woods, and none answer me.

lines.zh: 我脖子上是项圈，不是伴侣。
lines.en: There's a collar on my neck, not a mate.

lines.zh: 成对的狼会一起守夜。
lines.en: Paired wolves keep the night watch together.

lines.zh: 我记得她的毛色，是灰的。
lines.en: I remember her coat. It was grey.

lines.zh: 复活之后，气味都变淡了。
lines.en: Since coming back, every scent has faded.

lines.zh: 谁都不用替我找伴，我守你。
lines.en: No one needs to find me a mate; I guard you.

lines.zh: 我们那一窝，只剩下我。
lines.en: Of the whole litter, only I remain.

lines.zh: 我不叫了，叫了也没用。
lines.en: I don't howl now; it does no good.

lines.zh: 你在，我就还有一个群。
lines.en: With you here, I still have a pack.

lines.zh: 我把骨头叼回来，放在你脚边。
lines.en: I bring the bone back and lay it at your feet.

lines.zh: 项圈掉进沟里，我捞上来了。
lines.en: The collar fell in a ditch; I fished it out.

lines.zh: 这东西扎嘴，我换一边咬。
lines.en: This thing pricks my mouth; I'll bite the other side.

lines.zh: 我找到一块旧布，是你的。
lines.en: I found an old cloth. It's yours.

lines.zh: 等我放下，你再来拿。
lines.en: Wait until I set it down, then take it.

lines.zh: 我只会叼，不太会放。
lines.en: I can pick things up; putting them down is harder.

lines.zh: 这块肉我留着，给你。
lines.en: I saved this meat. It's for you.

lines.zh: 我在土里刨出半截铁链。
lines.en: I dug half a chain out of the dirt.

lines.zh: 咬着东西，我走路才稳。
lines.en: Carrying something keeps my walk steady.

lines.zh: 收好，我不想再挖一次。
lines.en: Keep it safe; I don't want to dig it up again.

lines.zh: 有东西在树后面动。
lines.en: Something is moving behind the trees.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵先贴下去。
lines.en: My ears flatten before I even growl.

lines.zh: 这个味道，是掠夺者的。
lines.en: This scent belongs to a pillager.

lines.zh: 它靠近了，我往前一步。
lines.en: It's closing in; I take one step forward.

lines.zh: 别出声，让我先听。
lines.en: Stay quiet; let me listen first.

lines.zh: 我挡在你和它中间。
lines.en: I put myself between you and it.

lines.zh: 骨头上的旧伤在提醒我。
lines.en: The old wound in my bone warns me.

lines.zh: 我伏下去，肚皮贴着草。
lines.en: I drop low, belly against the grass.

lines.zh: 它不认识我，正好。
lines.en: It doesn't know me. Good.

lines.zh: 我看见影子，比它先动。
lines.en: I see the shadow and move before it does.

lines.zh: 一只狼也能挡住一群。
lines.en: One wolf can still hold off a pack.

lines.zh: 目标定了，我不会改。
lines.en: The target is set; I won't change it.

lines.zh: 它退了，我就再压一步。
lines.en: It retreats; I press one step further.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，是给你听的。
lines.en: My growl is meant for you to hear.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，鼻子对着风。
lines.en: I raise my head and point my nose into the wind.

lines.zh: 我绕到侧面，那里没有甲。
lines.en: I circle to the flank, where there's no armor.

lines.zh: 它举盾，我从低处咬腿。
lines.en: It raises a shield; I bite low at the legs.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很慢，它听不出。
lines.en: My breathing is slow; it can't hear me.

lines.zh: 它的喉咙在跳，我等着。
lines.en: Its throat is pulsing; I wait.

lines.zh: 风在我背后，它闻不到我。
lines.en: The wind's at my back; it can't smell me.

lines.zh: 它转身的时候，露出后颈。
lines.en: When it turns, its nape shows.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了它会跑。
lines.en: I won't howl; it would run.

lines.zh: 你退到树后，我处理。
lines.en: Get behind the tree; I'll handle this.

lines.zh: 我一步一寸地挪过去。
lines.en: I creep forward one inch at a time.

lines.zh: 它的脚步乱了，我记住了。
lines.en: Its steps broke rhythm; I've noted it.

lines.zh: 我让它以为我只是条狗。
lines.en: I let it think I'm only a dog.

lines.zh: 它抬手了，我等的是这个。
lines.en: It raised its arm. That's what I waited for.

lines.zh: 我的牙已经贴上它的影子。
lines.en: My teeth are already on its shadow.

lines.zh: 别插手，让我收尾。
lines.en: Don't step in; let me finish it.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿，也能追上你。
lines.en: Even dragging a leg, I can catch you.

lines.zh: 它喘得厉害，我知道时候到了。
lines.en: It is panting hard; I know the moment has come.

lines.zh: 我低低地呜一声，不是怕。
lines.en: I give a low whine, and it is not fear.

lines.zh: 它退到墙边，那里没有路。
lines.en: It backs to the wall, and there is no way out.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的手腕，往下一扯。
lines.en: I clamp its wrist and drag down.

lines.zh: 这一口没咬穿，但留了印。
lines.en: The bite didn't pierce, but it left a mark.

lines.zh: 我扑倒它，压住它的胸口。
lines.en: I take it down and pin its chest.

lines.zh: 前爪按住，牙齿跟上。
lines.en: Forepaws hold; teeth follow.

lines.zh: 它用剑柄砸我，我松口又咬。
lines.en: It hammers me with a hilt; I release and bite again.

lines.zh: 我身上挨了一下，值得。
lines.en: I took a hit. It was worth it.

lines.zh: 骨头磕到骨头，声音很响。
lines.en: Bone knocks bone, loud and hollow.

lines.zh: 它流血了，我闻到铁味。
lines.en: It's bleeding; I smell the iron.

lines.zh: 我拖住它的腿，它走不动。
lines.en: I hold its leg; it can't walk away.

lines.zh: 这一口是替上一只狼咬的。
lines.en: This bite is for the wolf before me.

lines.zh: 我的下巴发麻，但没松。
lines.en: My jaw is numb, but I don't let go.

lines.zh: 它倒下，我退开两步。
lines.en: It falls; I back off two steps.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身上的血。
lines.en: I shake the blood off my coat.

lines.zh: 结束了，我回来找你。
lines.en: It's over. I'm coming back to you.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，骨头也在用力。
lines.en: I bite and hold, even my bones straining.

lines.zh: 这一下慢，但压得很沉。
lines.en: This one is slow, but it lands heavily.

lines.zh: 项圈压上锚，我撑起前腿。
lines.en: The collar touched the anchor; I pushed my forelegs out.

lines.zh: 我先闻到土，再闻到你的手。
lines.en: I smelled soil first, then your hand.

lines.zh: 喉咙里有一声没叫出的嚎。
lines.en: A howl sits in my throat, unvoiced.

lines.zh: 我记得倒下的那一下。
lines.en: I remember the blow that took me down.

lines.zh: 项圈还是原来那条，磨旧了。
lines.en: The same collar, worn thin now.

lines.zh: 我站起来，比你矮不了多少。
lines.en: I stand up, not much shorter than you.

lines.zh: 我还认得你的味道，没变。
lines.en: I still know your scent. It hasn't changed.

lines.zh: 别急着抱我，我身上是凉的。
lines.en: Don't hug me yet; I'm cold all over.

lines.zh: 我转了一圈，确认这里是家。
lines.en: I turn in a circle to be sure this is home.

lines.zh: 虚弱药水留着，我还不想回去。
lines.en: Keep the weakness potion; I'm not ready to go back.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气没有温度。
lines.en: My first breath has no warmth in it.

lines.zh: 我听见你叫我名字，就爬出来。
lines.en: I heard you say my name and clawed my way out.

lines.zh: 这具身体沉得不像我。
lines.en: This body weighs more than it should.

lines.zh: 从今天起，我继续守着门口。
lines.en: From today, I keep guarding the door.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到我的毛，焦味刺鼻。
lines.en: Flames lick my coat; the stench is sharp.

lines.zh: 我从崖上滚下来，摔得闷响。
lines.en: I rolled off the cliff and landed with a thud.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我不再挣扎。
lines.en: Water fills my throat; I stop struggling.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀出好几格。
lines.en: The blast threw me several blocks.

lines.zh: 箭卡在肋骨间，动就疼。
lines.en: An arrow's wedged between my ribs; it hurts to move.

lines.zh: 法术烧得我毛根发烫。
lines.en: The spell sears the roots of my fur.

lines.zh: 这具身体不需要喂。
lines.en: This body doesn't need feeding.

lines.zh: 雷落在背上，我闻到焦味。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back; I smell it burning.

lines.zh: 下面没有土，也没有味道。
lines.en: Below there's no soil, and no scent at all.
